biggest_catch: Only for people who live or work in Humboldt, Del Norte, or Trinity County, California; bonus posts on the 91st day after account opening.
catches: Must use promo code 'local checking bonus' to qualify for this offer.
Offer is available only to anyone who lives or works in Humboldt, Del Norte or Trinity County, California.
Open a Compass Directional Checking Account with a minimum of $5.00.
Direct deposit is required, totaling $750 or more, within 90 days of account opening.
Enrollment in online banking with e-Statements is required, and a minimum of $400 in debit card purchases is required, within 90 days of account opening.
The $250 will be deposited to your savings account on the 91st day from the account open date; may be subject to 1099 reporting.
One offer per social security number; offer for a limited time only.
Taxes due are the responsibility of the recipient.
